name: ess-specify
description: Validate ESS schemas, guide deterministic projections, and audit conformance coverage without guessing semantics.

interface.shortDescription: Validate, project and conformance-test typed ESS contracts.
interface.longDescription: Validate Executable System Specifications, inspect compiled IR, guide deterministic JSON Schema and OpenAPI projections with explicit coverage gaps and refusals, and raise or audit a conformance suite against a real implementation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use ess-specify to validate, project or conformance-test this system contract.
